cards.note: External plugin is an npm package declared through dsh.bundle.patch and installed through the single official profile path (profile bundle list); a cold boot mounts the upgrade-demo row, and no repository-plugin artifact (dsh.plugin.json, repository row) exists.
No client half: package.json has never declared the legacy dshClient field, dsh.client, or a dsh.plugin.json.
No Web Client half, so client-modules has nothing to enumerate for this package.
index.js consumes only ctx.llm, which inject declares; it uses no ctx.get and no undeclared property access.
llm is a required service guaranteed by the dsh-base layer of the probe composition; the probe has no optional host service to weaken.
Subscribes to no session/event and derives no session state.
Host-only plugin; it has no client half that could consume ctx.sessions.
Tails no task/job output and never used tasks.peek.
Injects neither httpServer/webServer nor tasks/jobs and registers no onTaskDone listener.
No ImageAttachmentRef, read_image output, or persisted image metadata schema.
Does not register, wrap, parse, or snapshot-test read_image.
No custom LLM adapter, image request interceptor, or attachment/upload cache.

Hit the removed Host APIProxy (ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers()). Migrated to the owning LlmRuntime service: ctx.llm.listProviders() + ctx.llm.listConfigurableProviders(); the removed @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy dependency is replaced by @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm.
Target is alpha.2, not alpha.1 (A2-01 restores the field); the plugin produces no persisted SessionEvents in any case.
No harness source patch and no import from internal session-view paths; it uses only the public llm service.
No launcher wrapper, SDK/ACP integration, or direct profile-file read; composition stays in the bundle patch.
Not a headless wrapper or output parser; the boot check classifies dsh's own exit code and streams.
Uses no tool presentation mode, PTC preset, or dispatch waterfall.
No permission, approval, or WebFetch policy plugin, and it ships no shipped preset.
Registers no loopback HTTP/WS/RPC route, browser page, or custom /api route.
Not a model-provider plugin; it only reads the provider directory.
Ships no localization resources and carries no custom i18n patch.
No subagent orchestration and no provider/model selector.
Deployment/privacy surface: plugin code needs no change; package-name reporting is owned by the dsh-base row, not by this bundle.
No PowerShell/Bash persistence or Windows directory-picker workaround.
No session-log-deepseek egress and no delivery watermark.
No browser acceptance script or client bundle; the boot check follows the host's printed output and exit code.
Registers no structured-question answerer.
Infers no agent preset from a persisted session and sets no agent-presets roots.
No token-delta detection and no TPS computation.
Insert-only bundle layer; it owns no base rows and states no telemetry/privacy stance.
Imports no provider adapter and never touches @earendil-works/pi-ai.
No client half; no @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime import and no dsh.client.inject entry.
No client registration id; the only id is the Host profile row id upgrade-demo, which is not a client-modules key.
Reads no session timeline, transcript, or user-message content.
Manipulates no composer DOM.
Renders no ui-primitives MarkdownText or fenced CodeBlock.
Consumes no client ctx.connection.api face.
Constructs no subagent seed/persisted descriptor and asserts no descriptor version.
Calls no workspaces navigation method and reads no workspaces.list snapshot fields.
Target already restores the field; the plugin writes no persisted SessionEvents.
Uses no ctx.remote call, so it handles no RemoteResult or RemoteError.

No lockfile or second package manager and no direct import of a moved type package; the manifest's single DSH entry was retargeted as an exact peer dependency under DSH-0.1.2-A1-01 and verified with a clean npm install.
No Web Client graph and no Node-version workaround; the verification boot runs on Node 24.21.0.
Consumes no pluginInventory/list snapshot.
No client Remote and no host.describe consumer.
Mounts none of the listed packages itself; the probe composes the shipped dsh-base and dsh-headless bundles.
Registers, reads, or writes no settings namespace and injects no settings service.
